main.name: Buggy (OP09-042)
main.effect: [Activate: Main] You may rest 5 of your DON!! cards and trash 1 card from your hand: Play up to 1 "Cross Guild" type Character card from your hand.

main.name: Crocodile & Mihawk
main.effect: [On Play] Draw 2 cards and trash 1 card from your hand. Then, play up to 1 "Cross Guild" type Character card with a cost of 4 or less from your hand. [Once Per Turn] If your "Cross Guild" type Character would be removed from the field by your opponent's effect, you may trash 1 card from your hand instead.

main.name: Alvida
main.effect: If you have 2 or more Characters with a base cost of 5 or more, this Character gains +1 cost. [On Play] If your Leader is [Buggy], draw 3 cards and trash 2 cards from your hand.

main.name: Buggy
main.effect: [Activate:Main] You may trash 1 card from your hand and trash this Character: If your Leader is [Buggy], play up to 1 "Cross Guild" type Character card with a cost of 6 or less from your hand.

main.name: Cabaji
main.effect: If you have 2 or more Characters with a base cost of 5 or more, this Character gains [Blocker] and +1 cost. (After your opponent declares an attack, you may rest this card to make it the new target of the attack.) [Opponent's Turn] This Character gains +5000 power.

main.name: Mohji
main.effect: If you have 2 or more Characters with a base cost of 5 or more, this Character gains [Blocker] and +1 cost. (After your opponent declares an attack, you may rest this card to make it the new target of the attack.) [On K.O.] If your Leader is [Buggy] and you have 3 or less cards in your hand, draw 1 card.

main.name: Buggy (Reprint)
main.effect: [On Play] Place up to 1 of your opponent's Characters at the bottom of the owner's deck. Then, if you do not have 5 Characters with a cost of 5 or more, place this Character at the bottom of the owner's deck. DISCLAIMER: This card is a reprint of the pre-existing card in the OP09 set. The main difference between this card and the original print is the inclusion of "EN" on the right side, by the copyright information.

main.name: Cross Guild (Reprint)
main.effect: [Main] Look at 4 cards from the top of your deck; reveal up to 1 "Cross Guild" type card and add it to your hand. Then, place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order. [Trigger] Activate this card's [Main] effect. DISCLAIMER: This card is a reprint of the pre-existing card in the OP09 set. The main difference between this card and the original print is the inclusion of "EN" on the right side, by the copyright information.
